import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows significant association with outcome
    p_values = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col]
        y = feats.y
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0])
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # If no feature is significantly associated, return empty design
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Find features with p < 0.05
    significant_features = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids) if p_values[i] < 0.05]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    correlated_pairs = set()
    for fid1 in significant_features:
        for fid2 in significant_features:
            if fid1 != fid2:
                col1 = feats.column(fid1)
                col2 = feats.column(fid2)
                corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0,1]
                if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                    correlated_pairs.add((min(fid1, fid2), max(fid1, fid2)))
    
    # Keep only one feature from each correlated pair
    kept_features = set()
    for fid1, fid2 in correlated_pairs:
        # Prefer the one with better p-value
        idx1 = feats.ids.index(fid1)
        idx2 = feats.ids.index(fid2)
        if p_values[idx1] < p_values[idx2]:
            kept_features.add(fid1)
        else:
            kept_features.add(fid2)
    
    # Build final feature list
    final_features = [f for f in significant_features if f not in kept_features]
    
    # Try to build a model with these features
    if len(final_features) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Use logistic regression with cross-validation to check for robustness
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(f) for f in final_features]]
    y = feats.y
    
    # Fit model and get coefficients
    model = LogisticRegression(penalty='l1', solver='liblinear', C=1.0)
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    scores = []
    
    for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(X, y):
        X_train, X_test = X[train_idx], X[test_idx]
        y_train, y_test = y[train_idx], y[test_idx]
        model.fit(X_train, y_train)
        scores.append(model.score(X_test, y_test))
    
    # If model performs well, select top features by coefficient magnitude
    if np.mean(scores) > 0.6:
        model.fit(X, y)
        coefs = np.abs(model.coef_[0])
        sorted_indices = np.argsort(coefs)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
        selected_features = [final_features[i] for i in sorted_indices]
        
        # Create loadings dictionary
        loadings = dict(zip(selected_features, model.coef_[0][sorted_indices]))
        
        # Return design with drivers and loadings
        return Design(
            drivers=tuple(selected_features),
            columns=tuple(selected_features),
            products=(),
            loadings=loadings
        )
    
    # No robust mechanism found
    return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
